description.value: The Radisson Hotel Vancouver Airport is a full-service branded hotel on Cambie Road in Richmond, positioned within a few kilometres of Vancouver International Airport. It sits at the edge of Richmond's extensive cycling network, making it a practical staging point for cyclists beginning or ending a BC tour with a flight. As an internationally branded airport hotel, it offers a broad range of standard traveller amenities within a larger property.
